spectra-care.title: Spectra Care: Telehealth & Hardware Platform
spectra-care.summary: Enterprise telehealth platform with Jetpack Compose, Agora video calling, and 6-in-1 medical monitor integration.
spectra-care.description: Production Android telehealth app built with Jetpack Compose and MVI architecture. Features low-latency Agora video consultations, reactive device drivers for Spectra Care 6-in-1 health monitors, and secure SOAP EHR data synchronization.
spectra-care.altText: Spectra Care — Android Native telehealth app with Agora video calling and Spectra IoT health monitor integration built by Muhammad Awais
highlights: Spectra Care 6-in-1 IoT health monitor sync
spectra-care.challenge: Unifying a fragmented doctor and patient app codebase while simultaneously integrating proprietary Spectra Care IoT hardware drivers and low-latency Agora video calling — without disrupting daily clinical operations.
spectra-care.solution: Rebuilt the platform from scratch using Jetpack Compose and MVI, creating a shared module architecture that decoupled IoT device communication from the UI layer via reactive Kotlin Flows. Agora SDK integration was wrapped in an abstraction layer enabling fault-tolerant reconnection logic.
spectra-care.outcome: A unified, rock-solid HealthTech platform used daily in live clinical environments with a 99%+ crash-free session rate and zero documented data-integrity failures across IoT device sync.

zouris.title: Zouris: Holistic Wellness Platform
zouris.summary: Cross-platform wellness app delivering guided sessions, audio streams, and affirmations.
zouris.description: Zouris is a holistic wellness platform engineered using Flutter where certified coaches and practitioners share guided sessions, meditations, and real-time audio streams with native UX performance across Android and iOS.
zouris.altText: Zouris wellness coaching app — cross-platform meditation and audio streaming platform built by Muhammad Awais
zouris.challenge: Delivering a premium, native-feeling wellness experience across both Android and iOS from a single Flutter codebase, with reliable background audio streaming and seamless coach-to-student session delivery.
zouris.solution: Leveraged Flutter BLoC for predictable state management across the session lifecycle, integrated a custom audio pipeline for low-latency streaming, and implemented Decompose Navigation for a scalable, screen-agnostic routing architecture.
zouris.outcome: A polished dual-platform app live on both Google Play and the App Store, delivering real-time guided wellness sessions to users across the UAE with consistently high store ratings.

egora-b2b.title: Egora B2B: Restaurant Partner Platform
egora-b2b.summary: White-labeled partner dashboard for restaurant owners to manage orders, pick-ups, and live reservations.
egora-b2b.description: White-labeled partner platform engineered using Flutter, Dio, and GetIt. Empowers restaurant owners to independently manage dine-in, pickup, QR code ordering, and thermal receipt printing with reliable payment integrations.
egora-b2b.altText: Egora B2B restaurant partner dashboard — order, reservation, and QR management built by Muhammad Awais
highlights: Real-time order sync and notification engine
egora-b2b.challenge: Building a white-labeled B2B dashboard that multiple restaurant brands could customize independently, while synchronizing real-time orders, QR codes, and receipt printing across heterogeneous hardware.
egora-b2b.solution: Architected a white-labeling configuration system in Flutter with theming and branding assets driven by a remote config API. Dio + GetIt provided clean dependency injection and a shared HTTP layer used across all tenant variants.
egora-b2b.outcome: Deployed across multiple restaurant partners, each running independently branded dashboards with zero shared-state conflicts and a stable real-time order sync pipeline.

egora.title: Egora: Smart Restaurant Ecosystem
egora.summary: High-scale restaurant ecosystem with QR ordering, reservation management, and Bluetooth hardware integrations.
egora.description: Scalable reservation and dining system built using Flutter and Jetpack Compose. Features QR code ordering, integrated XStax payment processing (10k+ monthly transactions), and custom Bluetooth thermal printer hardware drivers achieving 100% reliability.
egora.altText: Egora restaurant app — QR ordering, reservation system, and Bluetooth thermal printer integration built by Muhammad Awais
highlights: Bluetooth thermal printer integration with 50% reduced latency
XStax payment gateway processing 10k+ monthly transactions
egora.challenge: Building a scalable QR-based ordering and reservation system that could handle peak restaurant traffic while also reliably driving Bluetooth thermal printers from a mobile app — hardware that was notorious for pairing instability.
egora.solution: Designed a dedicated Bluetooth printer abstraction layer with retry logic and connection-state machines in Kotlin. The QR ordering engine used Socket.IO for instant order broadcast and XStax for PCI-compliant payment processing.
egora.outcome: 30% increase in customer adoption and a Bluetooth printing pipeline with 100% reliability and 50% reduced query latency, processing over 10,000 monthly transactions.

makernote.title: Makernote: Interactive EdTech
makernote.summary: Educational platform with real-time collaboration and offline synchronization.
makernote.description: High-performance educational platform for teachers and students — engineered with Clean Architecture for real-time collaboration, instant note synchronization, and seamless offline data persistence.
makernote.altText: Makernote EdTech app — real-time collaboration and offline synchronization built by Muhammad Awais
makernote.challenge: Delivering a collaborative EdTech experience where teachers and students could work on shared boards simultaneously, with full offline support when school networks were unreliable.
makernote.solution: Implemented an offline-first architecture using local SQLite storage with a background sync queue. Real-time collaboration was driven by a WebSocket layer abstracted cleanly from the MVVM business logic.
makernote.outcome: A robust classroom tool live on the App Store that teachers trust for daily lesson delivery, with AI/ML-powered handwriting recognition as a standout capability.

eco-grocery.title: Eco Grocery: Smart Inventory Tracker
eco-grocery.summary: Smart grocery tracking app with barcode scanning, recipe recommendations, and expiry alerts.
eco-grocery.description: Intelligent Android utility app featuring a dynamic grocery list linked to a recipe recommendation engine, paired with built-in camera barcode scanning for instant item cataloging and expiry management.
eco-grocery.altText: Eco Grocery Android app — barcode scanning grocery tracker built by Muhammad Awais
eco-grocery.challenge: Building a grocery management experience that felt genuinely smart — not just a list app — by combining barcode scanning, expiry tracking, and personalized recipe recommendations in a single cohesive flow.
eco-grocery.solution: Integrated ML Kit barcode scanning with Room DB for local item persistence, and connected a public recipe API to surface contextual meal suggestions based on in-stock items. WorkManager drove scheduled expiry notifications.
eco-grocery.outcome: A polished Android utility app with a standout barcode-to-recipe pipeline that clients praised for genuinely changing how households manage their weekly grocery cycle.

hcloud.title: HCloud: Clinic Management Suite
hcloud.summary: Enterprise operations portal for healthcare providers with appointment and prescription sync.
hcloud.description: Enterprise-grade clinic management application engineered for doctors. Built with MVVM, Hilt, and Room DB to enable real-time prescription creation, patient records management, and offline-first appointment scheduling.
hcloud.altText: HCloud clinic management suite — real-time prescription sync and appointment scheduling built by Muhammad Awais
highlights: Offline-first sync queue using Room DB
hcloud.challenge: Giving doctors a reliable prescription and appointment management tool that worked seamlessly even in hospital zones with intermittent internet connectivity — while staying perfectly in sync with the patient-facing app.
hcloud.solution: Designed an offline-first sync queue using Room DB as the single source of truth, with Retrofit handling background reconciliation when connectivity resumed. Hilt provided clean DI across the dual-app architecture.
hcloud.outcome: A live Play Store clinic suite used by healthcare professionals daily, with an offline-resilient prescription workflow that reduced administrative delays for medical teams.

healthwire.title: Healthwire: HealthTech Ecosystem
healthwire.summary: Leading healthcare application with 2M+ downloads, telemedicine, lab bookings, and secure payment integrations.
healthwire.description: Architected one of Pakistan's top healthcare platforms — powering pharmacy logistics, lab-test bookings, Twilio video consultations, and local payment gateways (Meezan, JazzCash, Foree) with a 99%+ crash-free session rate.
healthwire.altText: Healthwire healthcare app — pharmacy logistics, lab booking, and Twilio telemedicine built by Muhammad Awais
healthwire.challenge: Scaling a HealthTech superapp handling millions of active users — integrating Twilio video, three payment gateways, lab bookings, pharmacy logistics, and deep-link navigation — while maintaining a 99%+ crash-free rate under high-growth pressure.
healthwire.solution: Adopted MVVM with Hilt and Coroutines/Flow for a clean, reactive architecture. WorkManager handled background sync and FCM delivery. Migrated core screens progressively to Jetpack Compose while keeping the legacy XML base stable throughout the transition.
healthwire.outcome: One of Pakistan's most-downloaded healthcare apps with 2M+ installs, a 99%+ crash-free rate, and a 15% uplift in engagement directly attributed to the Twilio telemedicine integration.

dongamers.title: DonGamers: E-Sports Platform
dongamers.summary: Global gaming platform featuring real-time Pusher chat, tournament brackets, and optimized monetization.
dongamers.description: Engineered an international e-sports platform on Native Android. Migrated codebase from Java to Kotlin, architected scalable real-time chat using Pusher (+15% engagement), and optimized In-App Purchases and Google AdMob.
dongamers.altText: DonGamers e-sports platform — real-time chat and tournament tracking built by Muhammad Awais
dongamers.challenge: Migrating a large legacy Java codebase to Kotlin without breaking an internationally distributed app, while adding real-time chat infrastructure and improving monetization — all under tight release schedules.
dongamers.solution: Executed an incremental Java-to-Kotlin migration using Kotlin's Java interoperability. Pusher was integrated as the real-time chat backbone with a custom message queue for offline tolerance. AdMob and IAP monetization was A/B tested across user segments.
dongamers.outcome: 99% crash-free sessions globally, a 15% engagement uplift from real-time chat, and a 10% sales increase through optimized IAP and AdMob revenue strategies.

wallpaper.title: Wallpaper App Backend
wallpaper.summary: Node.js backend for a high-performance wallpaper platform.
wallpaper.description: A scalable Node.js backend built as part of web development services to power the wallpaper.devawais.com platform. Focused on fast API response times, efficient data handling, and robust architecture.
wallpaper.altText: Wallpaper App Node.js Backend built by Muhammad Awais
wallpaper.challenge: Building a backend capable of serving high-resolution wallpaper assets at low latency to a global audience, with efficient CDN-ready image delivery and a clean API surface.
wallpaper.solution: Architected a Node.js REST API with optimized asset serving, category-based filtering, and a lean data layer designed for CDN caching compatibility.
wallpaper.outcome: A live production backend powering wallpaper.devawais.com with fast API response times and a maintainable, extensible architecture.
